summary: Frontend-only branding audit for the new My Dream Projects® registered trademark. Verified navbar wordmark, footer copyright, hero eyebrow, project detail (plan sheet + title), contact office caption, EMI calculator title, SEO/meta/OG/Twitter/JSON-LD, no ™ anywhere, no ®® duplicates anywhere, project names do NOT carry ®, and regression smoke (projects list = 19, EMI sliders = 3, no console errors on home/projects/contact/project-detail/emi). All 9 test areas from the request passed.
critical_code_review_comments: Home.jsx is 957 lines — exceeds the 700-line guideline; consider splitting into HeroSection, FoundersSection, PartnersSection, JoinVentureSection etc. Not caused by this branding change but worth flagging.
BrandMark.Reg uses aria-hidden which is correct so screen readers don't read out ® twice; good.
Footer copyright uses `new Date().getFullYear()` — dynamic year confirmed as 2026.
